description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港，选择该项。
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域，选择该项。
description.en:
The region where the data management center of threat analysis is located. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Select this region if your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

- ap-southeast-1: Select this region if your assets are outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts in your enterprise.

title.zh: 关闭威胁分析已接入的云产品日志的投递

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem close-delivery --product-code sas --log-code cloud_siem_aegis_proc --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
